chapter_theme: The six adhvas (அத்துவாக்கள்), the paths of tattvas, mantras, letters, worlds, words and kalas through which the soul is bound: counting and searching them leaves seekers bewildered, but rising through the states to Siva's dance makes them all Sivaya.
structure_note: The count of the six adhvas (2184), seekers lost among them (2185), and their passing into Siva through the states and the dance (2186).

2184.reading: Thirty-six tattvas, seven crore mantras, fifty-one letters, two hundred and twenty-four worlds, eighty-one words and five kalas: so the paths came to be.
2184.nuance: The numbers match the six adhvas of Saiva Agamic tradition: tattva, mantra (மனு), varna (வன்னம்), bhuvana (மேதினி), pada (பதம்) and kala. The verse lists them without the word அத்துவா, which is the chapter title.

2185.reading: Those who study the three regions well, run along with the twenty-five within, gather together and follow the path by its marks are left bewildered after all their searching.
2185.nuance: மண்டலம் மூன்றும் is traditionally taken as the regions of fire, sun and moon in the body, and இருபத்துஐஞ்சு as the twenty-five tattvas. Whether the bewilderment is failure or the stunned arrival of the search is not plain; திகைத்திருந்தார் allows both.

2186.reading: Beginning from waking-within-waking and taking the gross body as the measure, one passes into the beyond and reaches the dance of love, becoming Siva, and then all five are Sivaya.
2186.nuance: ஐந்தும் சிவாயவே is traditionally taken as the five letters நமசிவாய losing ந and ம (taken as the malas) so that only சிவாய remains; the five may also be the five states. தாக்கிய (that strikes) with தாண்டவம் is unclear.

links.note: 2182 removes the five states, the five mala-states and the false thirty-six so that the soul stands as one; 2186 names where that ends, in the dance and in becoming Siva, with the five made Sivaya.

2184 counts the six paths: thirty-six tattvas, mantras, fifty-one letters, worlds, eighty-one words and five kalas. 2782 has 'the six paths of love' (அன்புறு மார்க்கங்கள் ஆறும்) dance with the Lord in the dance of bliss; the paths 2184 counts as the soul's bondage become, in 2782, part of Siva's dance.

2185 says those who study the three regions and follow the path by its marks (குறிவழியே சென்று) are left bewildered after searching (திகைத்திருந்தார்). 2955 asks whether the shore of the shoreless can be seen and says the Lord stands unveiled to those whose thought is clear as waveless water. On the reading of 2185 as failure, 2955 names the condition the searchers lacked.

2186 begins from waking-within-waking and ends in becoming Siva (சிவமாதல்) with the five as சிவாய. 2713 begins 'from ந and from waking' (நமாதி நனாதி) and ends with the syllables and samadhi as becoming Siva (சிவமாதல்); both join the states to the five syllables and end in the same word.
